params.prompt: Single continuous cinematic camera move, no cuts. Cinematic photorealistic live-action hybrid footage, vertical 9:16, shallow depth of field, real textures. Smooth, graceful, slow camera motion, subtle parallax. Absolutely no text, no captions, no logos. The camera continues the exact same slow, steady, perfectly straight forward drift it was already in, gliding toward the evening sky, as THE CRASH PAD sweeps in over the wooden fence like a parade float: a majestic fluffy glossy cotton-soft toy cloud the size of a small house carrying a golden star-shaped clubhouse with round brass porthole windows, a wooden balcony and a pink polka-dot party-hat spire, gift boxes and gold star balloons tucked into its folds. The sky warms from gold to pink-gold dusk, paper lanterns in pastel colors drift upward and warm string lights flicker on one by one as the party magic gathers. STARRY, the tall golden star character in a pink polka-dot party hat, waves from the balcony rail while the three CRASHERS in their round hooded onesies — orange zigzag, blue diamond, green paint-splatter — leap happily from the front cloud deck trailing ribbon streamers, and the small purple confetti cannon on the deck fires a soft arc of colorful confetti over the lawn. The cloud settles low over the yard, its golden sparkle trail streaming beneath it. In the final second, all motion eases and the camera settles into a slow, steady, perfectly straight forward drift down toward the center of the glowing party below, ready to continue.
